name: caffeinity-skills
description: Caffeinity skills marketplace: editing, teaching, recruiting, SEO, release orchestration, decision review, and multi-agent tournament plugins.

skills.name: wordsmith
skills.description: Edit, rewrite, critique and proofread while keeping the author's meaning, hedges and voice intact.

skills.name: recruiter-lens
skills.description: Review resumes, CVs and LinkedIn profiles the way recruiters screen them.

skills.name: applicant-kit
skills.description: Produce tailored job-application material from a resume and JD.

skills.name: topic-primer
skills.description: World-class teacher for any topic in eight modes from foundations to exams.

skills.name: application-pilot
skills.description: Coordinate job search: shortlist, fit scoring, tracker, follow-ups, briefings.

skills.name: do-better
skills.description: Single-elimination tournament of sub-agents with different strategy cards.

skills.name: keyword-guard
skills.description: Plan topic clusters and eliminate keyword cannibalization.

skills.name: web-preflight
skills.description: Check a site you own before shipping for accidental exposure and missing controls.

skills.name: findable
skills.description: Set up discovery for repos, skills, plugins and MCP servers.

skills.name: crash-test
skills.description: Crash-test decisions with four adversarial roles before building.

skills.name: pre-ship-performance-audit
skills.description: Audit and fix web app performance before launch with four read-only subagents.

skills.name: pre-ship-security-red-team
skills.description: Authorized red-team pass over a web app you own before launch.

skills.name: release-gate
skills.description: Three pre-launch passes (exposure, app-tests, perf) with one deterministic posture: HOLD or ready.

skills.name: upstream-check
skills.description: Check unpushed local commits and compare published listings against the repos that ship a SKILL.md.

skills.name: draft-skill
skills.description: Create a new agent skill from an idea, with sibling overlap checks and validation.

skills.name: prompts-to-skill
skills.description: Turn a list of your own prompts into a finished, tested skill, one per prompt.

skills.name: prompts-to-skill-release
skills.description: Package a finished skill for release, keeping failed trigger tests visible.

skills.name: tune-skill
skills.description: Audit and fine-tune a skill that already exists; ships the check_skill.py validator.
